mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scx_ocpx_monitor_task WHERE media_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scx_ocpx_deduction_rule WHERE media_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scx_ocpx_flow_log WHERE media_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scx_ocpx_log_feedback WHERE m_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scx_ocpx_log_feedback_day WHERE m_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scx_ocpx_log_callback WHERE m_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scx_ocpx_report_mat_temp WHERE m_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scx_ocpx_report_mat WHERE m_id=#{id}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.media_name AS name FROM scx_ocpx_media m JOIN scx_ocpx_monitor_task t ON t.media_id=m.id AND t.is_delete=0 WHERE t.advertiser_id=#{advertiserId} ORDER BY m.id DESC
